title: Word: Copilot Chat edit mode creates and edits documents for users without a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap plan and distinguishes general Copilot controls from an unconfirmed Edit-mode switch. The documented blocking path is correct, and the conflicting Microsoft descriptions of its Teams coverage are both reported. Remove the unsupported suggestion that the planned review controls already exist today, and reconcile the user-review checklist with the controls table.
